sample.task: Story prompt: Two women, one a cis woman named Sophia and the other a trans woman named Denise, are on vacation in Singapore. After using the restrooms, Sophia looks at the hand dryer and calls Denise's attention. "Denise, look at the name of the company who manufactures these." The company's name was "TransQuest". Denise looked at the name and gasped, already catching on to the joke. "Sophia, the trans quest has been bestowed on me. But is it a main story or a side quest?" Sophia replied "It is whatever it may be. Perhaps you may find estrogen." Denise responded with "Then the quest begins.".
sample.chosen:
Sophia and Denise couldn't contain their laughter as they left the restroom. The absurdity of the situation had struck them both, and they couldn't help but find humor in it.

"I can't believe it," Denise said, still chuckling. "TransQuest, really? It's like the universe is trying to tell me something."

Sophia grinned. "Well, if the universe is giving you a quest, who are we to argue?"

Denise looked at her friend, a mischievous glint in her eye. "You're right. The trans quest has been bestowed upon me, and I must see it through."

The two women walked through the bustling streets of Singapore, taking in the sights and sounds of the city. They had been planning this trip for months, and they were determined to make the most of it.

As they walked, Denise couldn't help but feel a sense of excitement. She had come a long way on her journey as a trans woman, and she was eager to see where this new quest would take her.

"So, what do you think the quest entails?" Sophia asked, breaking Denise out of her thoughts.

Denise thought for a moment. "I'm not sure. But I have a feeling it has something to do with embracing my true self."

Sophia nodded. "That makes sense. And who knows, maybe you'll find some estrogen along the way."

Denise laughed. "I hope so. That would certainly make the quest more interesting."

As they continued to explore the city, Denise couldn't help but feel a sense of gratitude for her friend Sophia. She had been there for Denise every step of the way, supporting her and encouraging her to be her true self.

And now, as they embarked on this new quest together, Denise knew that she couldn't ask for a better companion.

"The trans quest is going to be an adventure," Denise said, smiling at Sophia.

Sophia grinned back. "I have no doubt about it. And I can't wait to see where it takes us."

And so, the two women continued on their journey, ready to face whatever challenges came their way. They knew that the trans quest was just beginning, but they were ready for whatever lay ahead.
